2609.35032.title: JRDB-AVR: An Active Visual Reasoning Benchmark for Embodied Agents in Real-World Environments
2609.35032.paper_summary: In complex embodied visual reasoning scenarios, an agent often has only a limited field of view, and the evidence needed to answer a question may be distributed across time, viewpoint, and interacting objects. A model may therefore give a plausible answer without ever observing the relevant object, time, or view that supports it. Current visual reasoning benchmarks largely evaluate passive observations and final answers, overlooking settings that require active reasoning and evidence acquisition. We introduce JRDB-AVR, a benchmark derived from existing real-world JRDB robotics data through a structured question-generation engine that turns this gap into an explicit evaluation: an embodied agentic system receives a visual reasoning question, requests bounded observations by timestamp and viewing angle, and is evaluated on both the final answer and the grounded visual evidence supporting it. The benchmark contains diverse questions over multiple real-world environments involving temporal search, viewpoint selection, and human-oriented compositional reasoning. We also introduce JRDB-AVR-Agent, a reference active reasoning agentic method that maintains an explicit observation-grounded graph-based world model and answers through solving. Experiments reveal a substantial gap between answer accuracy and evidence accuracy in current baselines, showing that current VLMs can produce unsupported correct answers and that active evidence-aware evaluation is necessary for embodied visual reasoning. Code and benchmark are available at https://github.com/ControlNet/JRDB-AVR.
2609.35032.paper_summary_zh: 在複雜的具身視覺推理場景中，代理通常只有有限的視野，而回答問題所需的證據可能分佈在時間、視角和互動物體之間。因此，一個模型可能會給出一個合理的答案，而從未觀察到支持該答案的相關物體、時間或視角。目前的視覺推理基準主要評估被動觀察和最終答案，忽略了需要主動推理和證據獲取的設置。我們引入了JRDB-AVR，這是一個基於現有現實世界JRDB機器人數據的基準，通過一個結構化的問題生成引擎將這一差距轉化為明確的評估：一個具身的代理系統接收一個視覺推理問題，根據時間戳和視角請求有限的觀察，並在最終答案和支持該答案的具體視覺證據上進行評估。該基準包含多個現實世界環境中的多樣問題，涉及時間搜索、視角選擇和以人為中心的組合推理。我們還引入了JRDB-AVR-Agent，一種參考的主動推理代理方法，維護一個明確的基於觀察的圖形世界模型並通過解決問題來回答。實驗顯示，當前基準中答案準確性與證據準確性之間存在顯著差距，顯示當前的VLM可以產生不支持的正確答案，並且主動的證據感知評估對於具身視覺推理是必要的。代碼和基準可在https://github.com/ControlNet/JRDB-AVR獲得。
